detail.body:
## Purpose
This PR is to enable PD Disaggregation(in TP mode) for DeepSeek-V4-Pro Model on AMD GPUs

Related PR on vllm-router: https://github.com/vllm-project/router/pull/192

## Test Plan
Verification steps on MI355X-AINIC
STEP 1: Build ROCm VLLM Image
```
docker build -f ./docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base -t  <IMG_VLLM_ROCM_BASE>  . 

DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --no-cache  --target final --progress=plain -t  <FINAL_VLLM_IMAGE_NAME>  -f ./docker/Dockerfile.rocm  --build-
arg BASE_IMAGE=<IMG_VLLM_ROCM_BASE>   .
```
STEP 2: Please use below commands to start Prefill and Decode servers
```
## PREFILL
docker run --rm -i \
    --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
    --device /dev/dri \
    --device /dev/kfd \
    --device /dev/infiniband \
    --network host \
    --ipc host \
    --group-add "$(getent group video | cut -d: -f3)" \
    --group-add "$(getent group render | cut -d: -f3)" \
    --cap-add SYS_PTRACE \
    --cap-add IPC_LOCK \
    --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
    --shm-size 64G \
    --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
    --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 \
    -v <DATA_ROOT>:<DATA_ROOT> \
    -v <MORI_DIR>:/tmp/mori \
    -e HOME=<HOME_DIR> \
    -e USER="$(id -un)" \
    -e AITER_JIT_DIR=<JIT_CACHE_DIR> \
    -e FLYDSL_RUNTIME_CACHE_DIR=<FLYDSL_CACHE_DIR> \
    -e VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
    -e TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/triton_cache \
    -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/tmp/vllm_cache \
    -e MORI_RDMA_DEVICES=<RDMA_DEVICE_LIST> \
    -e MORI_IB_GID_INDEX=1 \
    -e MORI_SHMEM_HEAP_SIZE=16G \
    -e MORI_GPU_ARCHS=<GPU_ARCH> \
    -e NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=1 \
    --entrypoint bash \
    --name prefill \
    <CONTAINER_IMAGE> \
    -c 'vllm serve <MODEL_PATH> \
        -tp 8 \
        --port <HTTP_PORT> \
        --max-model-len 65536 \
        --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
        --enforce-eager \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --kv-transfer-config "{
            \"kv_connector\": \"MoRIIOConnector\",
            \"kv_role\": \"kv_producer\",
            \"kv_connector_extra_config\": {
                \"proxy_ip\": \"<PROXY_IP>\",
                \"proxy_ping_port\": \"<PROXY_PING_PORT>\",
                \"http_port\": \"<HTTP_PORT>\",
                \"handshake_port\": \"<HANDSHAKE_PORT>\",
                \"notify_port\": \"<NOTIFY_PORT>\"
            }
        }"' \
    2>&1 | tee <LOG_FILE> >/dev/null
    
## DECODE
    docker run --rm -i \
    --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
    --device /dev/dri \
    --device /dev/kfd \
    --device /dev/infiniband \
    --network host \
    --ipc host \
    --group-add "$(getent group video | cut -d: -f3)" \
    --group-add "$(getent group render | cut -d: -f3)" \
    --cap-add SYS_PTRACE \
    --cap-add IPC_LOCK \
    --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
    --shm-size 64G \
    --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
    --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 \
    -v <DATA_ROOT>:<DATA_ROOT> \
    -v <MORI_DIR>:/tmp/mori \
    -e HOME=<HOME_DIR> \
    -e USER="$(id -un)" \
    -e AITER_JIT_DIR=<AITER_JIT_DIR> \
    -e FLYDSL_RUNTIME_CACHE_DIR=<FLYDSL_CACHE_DIR> \
    -e VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
    -e TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/triton_cache \
    -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/tmp/vllm_cache \
    -e MORI_RDMA_DEVICES=<RDMA_DEVICE_LIST> \
    -e MORI_IB_GID_INDEX=1 \
    -e MORI_SHMEM_HEAP_SIZE=16G \
    -e MORI_GPU_ARCHS=<GPU_ARCH> \
    -e NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=1 \
    --entrypoint bash \
    --name decode \
    <CONTAINER_IMAGE> \
    -c 'vllm serve <MODEL_PATH> \
        -tp 8 \
        --port <HTTP_PORT> \
        --max-model-len 65536 \
        --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
        --enforce-eager \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --kv-transfer-config "{
            \"kv_connector\": \"MoRIIOConnector\",
            \"kv_role\": \"kv_consumer\",
            \"kv_connector_extra_config\": {
                \"proxy_ip\": \"<PROXY_IP>\",
                \"proxy_ping_port\": \"<PROXY_PING_PORT>\",
                \"http_port\": \"<HTTP_PORT>\",
                \"handshake_port\": \"<HANDSHAKE_PORT>\",
                \"notify_port\": \"<NOTIFY_PORT>\"
            }
        }"' \
    2>&1 | tee <LOG_FILE> >/dev/null &
`
```
STEP 3: Please run the following to start the vLLM Router
```
docker run --rm \
    --network host \
    --name proxy \
    vllm-router:fix-moriio-tp-size-c04b24f \
    vllm-router \
    --vllm-pd-disaggregation \
    --kv-connector moriio \
    --vllm-discovery-address "0.0.0.0:36367" \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 30000  2>&1 | tee /data/scratch/vpolamre/DSV4-Logs/router.log > /dev/null &
```
STEP 4: Please run the following to perform the accuracy test
```
## Exec to prefill node container
docker exec -it prefill bash

## lm-eval command
python3 -m lm_eval \
        --model local-completions \
        --tasks gsm8k \
        --model_args 'model=/data/models2/DeepSeek-V4-Pro,base_url=http://<PROXY_PING_PORT>:<PROXY_PING_PORT>/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,trust_remote_code=True'
```

## Test Result
|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9530|±  |0.0058|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9522|±  |0.0059|
---
<details>
<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [x] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".
- [x] The test plan, such as providing test command.
- [x] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results
- [ ] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model.
</details>

inline_comments.body:
⚪ **Severity: LOW**

The `total_bytes` calculation uses `shape[0] * stride(0)` which overestimates by `(stride(0) - inner_dim_elements) * element_size` bytes beyond the tensor's actual storage. The resulting `torch.as_strided` view (which bypasses bounds checking) extends past the allocation and is then registered for RDMA via `register_local_tensor`. The existing `iter_layer_registration_regions` in `moriio_layout.py` correctly uses `(N-1)*stride + last_block_size` to avoid this exact over-read. A remote peer could RDMA-read adjacent GPU memory.
Helpful? Add 👍 / 👎

<details>
<summary>💡 Fix Suggestion</summary>

**Suggestion:** Replace the `total_bytes` calculation on line 1774 with the correct formula `((N-1) * stride + inner_dim_elements) * element_size` instead of `N * stride * element_size`. The current formula overestimates the size by `(stride(0) - inner_dim_elements) * element_size` bytes, causing the `torch.as_strided` view to extend past the tensor's actual storage. This is consistent with the correct formula already used in `iter_layer_registration_regions` in `moriio_layout.py` (line 256): `(geometry.num_blocks - 1) * block_stride_bytes + geometry.block_len`. Use `kv_cache[0].numel()` to get the number of elements in the inner dimensions (product of `shape[1:]`).

> **⚠️ Experimental Feature**: This code suggestion is automatically generated. Please review carefully.

```suggestion
                    ((kv_cache.shape[0] - 1) * kv_cache.stride(0) + kv_cache[0].numel()) * kv_cache.element_size()
```

</details>
